title: Army NCO club band; Dick Libertini; Bob Preston
summary: He played at an Army NCO club and mentions Dick Libertini and Bob Preston.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: So then I went in the Army, and I used to play at the NCO club -- I had a little band up there. And I used to get a little bombed. Everybody got so bombed that they had to move around. It was Saturday Night at the NCO club. The Army... Who gave a shit. Army. Not those guys. Generals and everybody else are drunk, so why not us?
That's where I met...there was this guy...he was on Broadway, a very talented guy. He's out in California now. I can't think of his name.
Oh, I saw Dick Libertini the other...! You remember him?

Saw him the other night. He came over and sat down at the table. I don't know what happened to him. All of a sudden I had to go to work, and that's the last I saw of him. Dick Libertini. He went to Hollywood. He scored, made three or four or five pictures. I don't know what he's doing now. He said he was back here doing some picture or something like that.
I got to know Bob Preston when I was with Peggy. He was going with her.
